principle: Primary ownership follows the nature of the core problem. Procurement collaborates where supplier, commercial or buying-process action is part of the solution.

bank_change.procurement: Supplier relationship context only; never bypass payment controls.

stock_mismatch.procurement: Only if supplier/receipt evidence becomes relevant.

liability_clause.procurement: Commercial context and supplier negotiation interface.

forecast_increase.procurement: Supplier capacity/commercial response after demand is defined.

shadow_timelines.supplier_everything: Control owners bypassed; Procurement becomes a catch-all queue.
shadow_timelines.money_everything: Spend is confused with functional authority.
shadow_timelines.po_only: Procurement is reduced to transaction administration and misses supplier/commercial value.
shadow_timelines.owner_plus_collaborators: Accountability remains clear without pretending work is siloed.
